channel.title: Kuldeep Chandra Vishwakarma | Journal & Essays
channel.description: Technical essays, engineering post-mortems, and personal writing by Kuldeep Chandra Vishwakarma.

item.title: Cutting LLM Inference Costs by 42% with Hybrid Semantic Caching (pgvector + Redis)
item.description: A practical engineering guide to combining L1 Redis exact-hash lookups with L2 pgvector HNSW similarity search and temporal TTL guards in Next.js 16.

item.title: Engineering Sub-100ms Healthcare Platforms: Lessons from Production Launches
item.description: What building live digital platforms for Vijaya Home Healthcare and Sapthagiri Health Care taught me about mobile speed, local SEO, and patient UX.

item.title: Migrating to Next.js 16 & Turbopack: What Broke, What Flew, and Edge Gotchas
item.description: A candid engineering post-mortem on adopting Next.js 16 App Router and Turbopack in production.

item.title: Building an Automated AI News Feed using Next.js & Gemini
item.description: A deep-dive guide on how to parse RSS feeds, run them through Google Gemini for relevance, and automatically publish posts.

item.title: How to Achieve a 100 Lighthouse Performance Rating in Next.js
item.description: Learn the exact performance optimization techniques used to get a 100 Lighthouse score on this portfolio and StartupWire.
